tokens.npc_dota_hero_juggernaut_bio: No one has ever seen the face hidden beneath the mask of Yurnero the Juggernaut. It is only speculation that he even has one. For defying a corrupt lord, Yurnero was exiled from the ancient Isle of Masks--a punishment that saved his life. The isle soon after vanished beneath the waves in a night of vengeful magic. He alone remains to carry on the Isle's long Juggernaut tradition, one of ritual and swordplay. The last practitioner of the art, Yurnero's confidence and courage are the result of endless practice; his inventive bladework proves that he has never stopped challenging himself. Still, his motives are as unreadable as his expression. For a hero who has lost everything twice over, he fights as if victory is a foregone conclusion.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_juggernaut_hype: In a flurry of slashes, Juggernaut cuts down his foes. Sprinting and spinning into battle with reckless abandon, and nearly invincible once he is able to begin his assault, stopping Juggernaut can often be just as difficult as surviving him.

Becomes debuff immune and deals damage to nearby enemy units within a fixed interval.

Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
Blade Fury: Providing spell immunity and dealing damage every second.

* The ability has the following properties:
** Cannot be cast while {{A|Juggernaut|Omnislash}}-based abilities are active, and vice versa.
** Does not interrupt Juggernaut's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Grants the following bonuses upon cast:
**** Applies a {{M|basic dispel}} on Juggernaut.
**** {{M|Debuff immunity}}.
**** Bonus {{M|magic resistance}}.
**** {{Symbol|bonus t2l}} Flat {{M|movement speed}} bonus.
*** Reduces Juggernaut's {{M|main attack damage|text=main}} and {{M|bonus attack damage}} upon his {{M|attack point}}, despite the reduction values not displayed on the [[HUD]].
**** Does not affect bonus {{M|conditional attack damage}} sources.
**** Stacks additively with other total attack damage reduction sources.
**** Does not affect attacks on the following enemy units:
***** {{M|Buildings}}
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
*** Applies a {{M|strong dispel}} on Juggernaut at the end of the duration that dispels the only first applied debuff while Blade Fury is active, including the following conditions:
**** While {{M|hidden}}.
**** Upon Juggernaut's {{M|death}}.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** {{Symbol|Damage|Magical}} {{Symbol|Spell Damage}}
**** Deals {{calc|v1*{{#var:Blade Fury value2}}|v1={{#var:Blade Fury value3}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1*{{#var:Blade Fury value2}}|v1={{#var:Blade Fury value3 tal}}}}|20tal}}) [[magical]] [[spell damage]] in {{#var:Blade Fury value2}}-second intervals, starting {{#var:Blade Fury value2}} seconds after debuff application, over {{#expr:{{#var:Blade Fury value4}}/{{#var:Blade Fury value2}}}} damage instances.
**** The {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|juggernaut_blade_fury}} debuff has the following additional properties:
***** Reapplying the debuff does not update the damage values of the first applied debuff.
***** However, Blade Fury of different sources applies its debuff and damage values independently.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_juggernaut
data.bio_loc: No one has ever seen the face hidden beneath the mask of Yurnero the Juggernaut. It is only speculation that he even has one. For defying a corrupt lord, Yurnero was exiled from the ancient Isle of Masks--a punishment that saved his life. The isle soon after vanished beneath the waves in a night of vengeful magic. He alone remains to carry on the Isle's long Juggernaut tradition, one of ritual and swordplay. The last practitioner of the art, Yurnero's confidence and courage are the result of endless practice; his inventive bladework proves that he has never stopped challenging himself. Still, his motives are as unreadable as his expression. For a hero who has lost everything twice over, he fights as if victory is a foregone conclusion.
data.hype_loc: In a flurry of slashes, Juggernaut cuts down his foes. Sprinting and spinning into battle with reckless abandon, and nearly invincible once he is able to begin his assault, stopping Juggernaut can often be just as difficult as surviving him.
data.npe_desc_loc: Slices through his enemies with precise strikes

abilities.name: juggernaut_blade_fury
abilities.desc_loc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
abilities.lore_loc: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.
notes_loc: You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.
abilities.scepter_loc:
Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect.

Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every %attack_interval%s.

abilities.name: juggernaut_healing_ward
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.
notes_loc: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.

abilities.name: juggernaut_blade_dance
abilities.desc_loc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
abilities.lore_loc: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.

abilities.lore_loc: A briefer onslaught for those less deserving of the honor.

abilities.name: juggernaut_bladeform
abilities.desc_loc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every %stack_gain_time%s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
